warnings: Every footing is printed 'F<n>,C2' — footing mark + the column stub C2 standing on it (C2 = 0.20x0.20, 6-DB12 on S-05). C2 is recorded here once (15 points); the floor-level columns are C1 on S-02.
Row B'' (5.00 = B + 1.70) carries a full row of footings: F1 at B''1/B''3, F2 at B''2.
F2 caps (two piles, 0.90 x 0.36 on S-04) are drawn with the 0.90 side along x, all on grid 2 (rows A, B, B'', C). D2 is F1 (single pile), not F2.
